queryLabelRules.site-maintenance: query starts with the `site:` operator (index/site maintenance lookups)
queryLabelRules.brand: query contains a brand token (case-insensitive substring): "cubxxw", "nsddd", "bear os", "xinwei xiong"
queryLabelRules.ambiguous-anomalous-heuristic: transparent anomaly heuristics: URL-like text (http(s):// or www.), a token repeated 3+ times, more than 12 tokens, more than 100 characters, or control characters — a flag for review, not a judgment of intent or quality
queryLabelRules.caveat: Labels describe the query string only. Landing pages are never inferred; query×page evidence exists only where the real page dimension was returned.
